died.name: John Hooper
died.desc: Anglican Bishop of Gloucester and Worcester, Protestant martyr
died.cause: refusing a pardon prior to burning at the stake for heresy
died.last_words: If you love my soul, away with it!

died.name: Rowland Taylor
died.cause: while being burned at the stake for heresy
died.last_words: Merciful Father of heaven, for Jesus Christ my Savior's sake, receive my soul into Thy hand.

died.name: Lucilio Vanini
died.cause: prior to execution by strangling and burning for atheism and blasphemy
died.last_words: They sweat in extremes, for fear of the unwarlike; I am dying undisturbed

died.name: George Lippard
died.desc: American author, social activist and labor organizer

died.name: Jules Michelet
died.last_words: Linen, doctor? You speak of linen? Do you know what linen is? The linen of the peasant, of the worker? Linen is a great thing. I want to make a book of it.

died.name: Osamu Tezuka
died.cause: to a nurse who tried to take away his drawing equipment
died.last_words: I'm begging you, let me work!

born.name: Richard Burke Jr.
born.desc: English barrister and Member of Parliament
born.cause: quoting the Morning Hymn from Paradise Lost to his father, Edmund Burke; he then died in his father's arms
born.last_words: His praise, ye winds, that from four quarters blow, / Blow soft or loud; and wave your tops, ye pines, / With every plant, in sign of worship, wave.

born.name: William Henry Harrison
born.cause: to his doctor but possibly intended for John Tyler, his vice-president and successor The 9th President of the United States died a month after his inauguration from an illness (possibly pneumonia or enteric fever) that developed after he stood in the rain to deliver his 2-hour-long inaugural address, the longest by any U.S. President. Medical treatments Harrison received in the last week of his life included opium, castor oil and leeches. Harrison remains the U.S. President to have served the shortest term in office and was the first President to die in office.
born.last_words: Sir, I wish you to understand the true principles of the government. I wish them carried out. I ask nothing more.

born.name: Alban Berg
born.cause: to his wife, who had asked him to relax
born.last_words: But I have so little time.

born.name: Brendan Behan
born.last_words: You made one mistake. You married me.
